convert_model: convert a Higgs Audio v2 model from BosonAI format to HuggingFace format using safetensors weights
create_processor: create a HiggsAudioV2Processor with feature extractor, tokenizer, and audio tokenizer for inference
run_conversion_cli: run the Higgs Audio v2 conversion CLI to save or push model and processor to a directory or hub
convert_key: convert original model keys to HuggingFace key names using regex-based mapping rules
merge_partially_frozen_weights: merge partially frozen embedding and linear layer weights into single combined tensors
